t: This is the Royal Marines Memorial, a bronze sculpture on the north side of The Mall, next to Admiralty Arch. It shows two figures on a Portland stone plinth and dates from 1903. It remembers Royal Marines who died in the Boxer Rebellion in China and the Second Boer War in Africa. It is also called the Graspan memorial, after a battle the Marines took part in. The sculptor Adrian Jones was an army veterinary surgeon for twenty-three years before he became an artist, and he was known for his horses.
